commands.name: Unlimited health
commands.description: Keeps Koa’s energy and diving air full.

commands.name: Unlimited jumps
commands.description: Allows Koa to jump again in midair.

commands.name: Unlimited resources
commands.description: Fills acquired stacks to 99 and preserves inventory when items are used.

commands.name: Ignore crafting materials
commands.description: Crafts unlocked recipes without requiring or consuming materials.

commands.name: Movement speed
commands.description: Scales Koa’s movement speed from 1× to 3×.

commands.name: Instant crop growth
commands.description: Makes crops ready to harvest as soon as they are planted.

commands.name: Set coins
commands.description: Sets the coin balance from 0 to 1,000,000,000.

commands.name: Automatic fishing
commands.description: Hooks and reels in the fish after you start fishing.

commands.name: Freeze clock
commands.description: Stops the in-game clock from advancing.

commands.name: Map objective tracker
commands.description: Marks active objectives on the map and shows the direction and distance to the nearest mission NPC in the current area.
